d:
A colossal insectoid creature with a hard, chitinous exoskeleton in a brilliant cobalt-blue shade. The head features two massive, golden-yellow horn-like antennae and multifaceted, amber eyes. A segmented, thick cobalt-blue tail curves upward behind the sturdy, armored body. Three sharp claws on each thick, jointed limb.
BODY COLOR: cobalt-blue
